_comment: Per-node-type validation rules, as data (MIGRATION_PLAN.md §7.6 / L8).
Adding a check for a node type is an edit here, not a code change.
Kept out of node_types/*.json because those are generated from the source
registry and are verified byte-for-byte by gen_registry_resources.py --check.
Message templates take {label} and {type}. Severity is 'error' or 'warning'.
Wording is copied from agentBuilder/services/workflow_validator.py so the

workflow.message: Sub Flow node {label}: child workflow ID is not configured

rule.message: Rule node {label}: no rule branches defined
Rule node {label}: a branch is missing ruleId

variable.message: Variable node {label}: an update entry is missing variable path

output.message: Output node {label}: no output mappings defined

tool.message: Tool node {label}: handoff type requires a handoffTarget
